targetText: the war of 1914-18 was imperialist (that is, an annexationist, predatory war of plunder) on the part of both sides
summary: World War I was an imperialist war fought by both sides to divide global markets and colonial territories.
context: Lenin refutes propaganda from both Allied and Central powers, showing both fought for financial conquest.

targetText: Capitalism has grown into a world system of colonial oppression and of the financial strangulation
summary: Capitalism has grown into a world system of colonial oppression... this statement highlights key economic principles governing class relations under capitalism.
context: Essential theoretical analysis of capital, wages, and social relations.

targetText: bribe the labour leaders and the upper stratum of the labour aristocracy.
summary: Capitalists use colonial superprofits to pay higher wages to a privileged layer of domestic workers, co-opting them politically.
context: This explains why well-off working-class sectors in wealthy nations supported imperialist war over worker solidarity.
